headline: Magnitude 5.6 Earthquake Jolts Central and Western Colombia
summary: A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck early Tuesday, waking residents and prompting precautionary evacuations across central and western Colombia, including Bogotá.
why: Natural disasters and significant seismic events can cause regional disruptions to infrastructure, utilities, and local economic activity.
